summary: A mushroom hunter found what he believed to be a human skull in a heavily forested area between US Hwy 40 and Mary Jane Road; CBI, Fraser Winter Park Police Department, U.S. Forest Service, and the Grand County Coroner's Office recovered the skull plus several other bones nearby; Grand County SAR personnel searched a wider area for additional remains and found nothing more. Remains appeared to have been at the location for years; no identifying information or clothing found; forensic anthropology pending at publication.
location: Between US Hwy 40 and Mary Jane Road, Winter Park
